Every beast has a story. This beast is borne of vengeance. Vaewolf is coming to PS5® Wishlist now!

Vaewolf returns with a new trailer, pulling back the curtain on its dark story founded on a ceaseless quest for revenge.

Become the Vaewolf, a legendary hybrid of werewolf and vampire, harnessing devastating powers, awakening deadly new abilities, and hunting down the Viking clan responsible for the slaughter of your family. Transforms from a young elf survivor into an unstoppable one-man supernatural vengeance machine in this Hack and Slash power fantasy!

Rampage through an ancient Northern England brought with all hand-drawn environments; from the windswept mountains and lakes of the Overground to the forbidding caverns and ruins of the Underworld. Nothing will stop you in your quest for vengeance. Will you claim yours?

The hunt begins in 2027.

description:
https://www.playstation.com/games/cairn/

Start the climb of a lifetime: https://bit.ly/Cairn-PS5Store

On the Trail is a series of free DLCs for the award winning survival climbing game Cairn. Set out on the ascent of a lifetime with pro-climber Aava: climb anywhere, plan your route carefully, and manage your resources to survive the unforgiving ascent of Mount Kami. 

On the Trail brings climbers to new climbing spots and challenges. Find your route freely, solve fresh climbing problems and explore new iconic locations as you follow the trail of a legendary climber.

Cairn features realistic simulation that allows you to climb intuitively, anywhere. Find the best holds and place your hands and feet seamlessly with simple controls. Adapt your posture, effort and balance - if you're not careful, you will fall!
